summary: Senior 3D Character Artist creating realistic and stylized characters for PC and mobile games. Former Lead 3D Character Artist at Gameplay Galaxy, combining hands-on production with team guidance and art reviews. Work spans sculpting, clothing, grooming, retopology, UVs, PBR texturing and real-time optimization. I also develop Blender tools in Python and standalone software for character-art workflows.

bullets: Led and mentored the character-art team, reviewed work and organized production workflows.
Produced game-ready characters across sculpting, clothing, grooming, retopology, UVs and PBR texturing.
Collaborated with concept, animation and engineering on character production and integration.
Modeled and textured characters, props and environments for in-game use.
Supported rigging, engine integration and generalist work for prototypes and indie productions.
Delivered custom 3D assets for international clients in games, AR/VR and animation.
Adapted visual style and asset complexity to each project and target platform.
Promoted from 3D Generalist to Lead after approximately three months.
Produced modeling, texturing, rigging, animation and game-engine integration work.
Guided artists and organized production workflows while remaining involved in asset delivery.
